title: Goodreads Genre Drift by Quarter
dataSources: Highlights (`reading:highlight`), book activity (`reading:book`), reviews (`reading:review`), paper libraries (`research:paper`), sync states (`reading:sync`).
app: Reading and second-brain telemetry — Readwise review exports, Kindle highlights, Goodreads shelves, and Zotero research libraries — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reading:book platform="goodreads" genre=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as metric by _time genre
| sort 0 _time genre
description: Trends monthly books finished by genre for reading mix over time.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether reading mix over time are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `genre` on `reading:book` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly books finished.
visualization: Line chart of monthly books finished by genre.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds how books finished changes month by month for each genre so you can see whether reading mix over time are heading the right way.
